subject: Syndicate Labs — Trial Bridge Credit & Accelerator Intake
messages:
From: Emma Lowe <emma@syndicate.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Noah Patel <noah@syndicate.co>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Syndicate Labs — accelerator trial need: bridge credits request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the streaming latency numbers you showed are very promising for our product roadmap. We're currently in week 2 of our accelerator cohort and need a short bridge of additional trial capacity while we finalize procurement.

Two asks: can Redwood extend our trial credits by another 45 days, and would you be willing to approve an interim promotional allocation of $15k in usage credits tied to the accelerator cohort milestone (demo day on Aug 20)? I attached a simple scoring sheet that summarizes current usage and expected ramp.

We're on a tight cadence and a short credit bridge would let us run the end-to-end eval with our SI partner. Happy to run a quick call if you need more context.

Cheers,
Emma Lowe
Programs Lead, Syndicate Labs
emma@syndicate.co

Attachment: syndicate_trial_scoring.xlsx (spreadsheet, 34 KB)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma@syndicate.co>
Cc: Noah Patel <noah@syndicate.co>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Jul 2027 13:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Syndicate Labs — accelerator trial need: bridge credits request

Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the scoring sheet, I pulled it in. Quick notes:

- We can usually do short trial extensions for accelerator partners; approvals depend on spend profile and expected adoption.
- I looped in Marissa to confirm the promotional allocation (she handles program credits).
- If you can confirm the single point milestone (demo day 2027-08-20) and agree to a one-off usage cap of $15k, I'll move this to operations for provisioning.

Would prefer a short E-mail confirmation from your side that the credit is tied to the accelerator cohort and not transferrable. If OK I can try to get an expedited sign-off today.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise GTM — Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Syndicate Labs — accelerator trial need: bridge credits request

Karthik / Vivek — forwarding Syndicate's request. Quick background: this is a seed-stage cohort (12 teams) — Syndicate runs a well-regarded program and has been a good source of downstream customers.

Notes from my side:
- $15k promotional credit tied to cohort deliverable is reasonable as a one-time allowance.
- Need confirmation of non-transfer clause and a brief terms sheet (pilot-credit-term-sheet.pdf) added to the customer record.
- Recommend we make this a 45-day extension + $15k promo, with a usage cap and an automatic downgrade to pay-as-you-go once credits are exhausted.

Approve? If yes I will sign the internal promo form and route to ops.

Marissa Cole
Head of Growth Programs — Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
Attachment: pilot-credit-term-sheet.pdf (pdf, 12 KB)

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Syndicate Labs — accelerator trial need: bridge credits request

Thanks for the details. I support approving this under the following quick guardrails:

- $15k promotional credit for 45 days (no extensions without leadership review).
- Credit tied to Syndicate Labs cohort/teams only, non-transferable.
- Require a short post-demo report (one page) from Syndicate summarizing usage and conversion intent — helps us evaluate uplift.
- Ops to set a hard usage cap and alert at 60% consumption.

Marissa — if you want to push to Ops, mark it as "pilot_credit_promo: approved" and put a 45-day expiration from provisioning date.

Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Partnerships — Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Emma Lowe <emma@syndicate.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Noah Patel <noah@syndicate.co>
Date: Tue, 13 Jul 2027 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Approval: Syndicate Labs — 45-day trial extension + $15k promo

Emma / Noah — good news: Redwood will approve a 45-day extension of your trial plus a $15,000 promotional credit tied to the accelerator cohort. Key terms below (also attached):

- Promotion: $15,000 Redwood usage credits.
- Duration: 45 calendar days from provisioning.
- Eligibility: Applies only to accounts/teams explicitly enrolled by Syndicate Labs for the accelerator cohort; non-transferable.
- Consumption controls: hard usage cap, operations will set alerts at 60%/90% usage.
- Deliverable: 1-page post-demo summary due within 7 days of demo day (2027-08-20).

I've attached the term sheet and a DocuSign link to accept the promo. Please sign so ops can provision. If you'd like, we can set a 20-minute checkpoint this week to confirm which teams you'll enroll.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-syndicate-credits
Attachment: pilot-credit-term-sheet.pdf (pdf, 12 KB)

Thanks,
Karthik

From: Emma Lowe <emma@syndicate.co>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Noah Patel <noah@syndicate.co>
Date: Wed, 14 Jul 2027 16:23:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Approval: Syndicate Labs — 45-day trial extension + $15k promo

Amazing — thank you all. We reviewed the term sheet and signed via DocuSign (signed copy attached). We'll send over the list of enrolled teams by EOD Thursday and will prepare the one-page post-demo report after Aug 20.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

—Emma
Programs Lead, Syndicate Labs
Attachment: signed_promo_agreement.pdf (pdf, 9 KB)
